capabilities: Log meals and ingredients by occasion from tagged notes
Chart nine nutrients and DASH food-group servings against targets
Score each day, week or month against floor and ceiling bars
Export day, week or month nutrition reports as markdown notes
Draft and estimate foods with optional Claude API features
disambiguation: Not a general AI chat or recipe assistant; the AI features only draft, estimate and discuss food logs against nutrition targets.
extras: Works offline; AI features are off until an API key is added. API key is stored in Obsidian's keychain (Obsidian 1.11.4+); on older Obsidian it is stored in plain text in data.json inside the vault. Optional Apple Health export requires a user-built or provided Shortcut run once daily; running it twice double-counts. Includes two companion Agent Skills for Claude, sample notes, and a claude.ai 'Cook this with Claude' link on drafted recipes. MIT licensed; targets follow the DASH 2,000 kcal pattern and are not medical advice.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log daily food intake and compare nutrient and food-group totals against dietary targets.

requires.name: Anthropic API billing at API rates

summary: Nutrition tracker that logs meals and ingredients from vault notes and charts nutrient and DASH food-group totals against editable targets.
